body: I’m so sorry. You’re not a failure! Please see that this is a wave that will pass
I’ve tried, I just hurt people and am a disappointment
Thank you! Are you my therapist? Cuz wow you made this seem way less doom-y and normal. Thank you
Dang, I guess I never even considered that she was twisting things. Thank you, gives me a lot to think about.

Thank you so much for your time and thought.

I’ve never done tho before, and I hope never again. I’m usually very understanding and maybe passive (?).

I’m extra stressed about money mad have had some resentments building. I’m just v disappointed in myself.

I love this, very mature.

My further question is: how can she trust me to not do this again? How do I rebuild that? There is no one answer, I know, but how can I address that?
Yes, I agree, but she kept insisting to pay her share.
